title: Other Questions
masterContent: Lambda Feedback supports a whole host of response areas, a whole list with descriptions can be found here: [https://lambda-feedback.github.io/user-documentation/teacher/reference/response\\\_area\\\_components/](https://lambda-feedback.github.io/user-documentation/teacher/reference/response\\\_area\\\_components/)

parts.content:
Examples of other types include matrices

What is $A + B$? For the following matrices:

$$
A=\left[\begin{matrix}2&4a \\ a &3+a\end{matrix}\right],B=\left[\begin{matrix} 5&2a \\ 0 &1\end{matrix}\right]
$$

responseAreas.contentAfter: This used "arraySymbolicEqual" to check if the student's reponse is equal to the answer.

workedSolution.content:
To add a matrix, add the corresponding elements in each matrix:

---

$$
A + B = \left[\begin{matrix}2 + 5 & 4a + 2a \\ a + 0 & 3 + a \end{matrix}\right]
$$

---

$$
A + B = \left[\begin{matrix}7 & 6a \\ a & 4+a \end{matrix}\right]
$$

parts.content:
Another question type is Essay, which is commonly evaluated with a ChatGPT based evaluation function.

Write a short sentence on approximately how many staff and students are at Imperial.

responseAreas.contentAfter: The feedback uses ChatGPT. Careful prompting is key as errors can easily slip in!

gradeParams.main_prompt: The question is: Write a short sentence on approximately how many staff and students are at Imperial.The answer is Imperial has approximately 22000 students and 8000 staff but these numbers are always changing, so they are very approximate (e.g. +/- 1k students is the equally valid).
gradeParams.default_prompt: Output a Boolean: True if the student is correct and False if the student is incorrect
gradeParams.feedback_prompt: Give objective feedback. No please or thank you. Be constructive. Don't be too pedantic. Short answer.

tests.payload: Imperial has approximately 22000 students and 8000 staff.

responseInput.answer: Imperial has approximately 22000 students and 8000 staff.
